title: Missing items
description: A few new blocks that will improve the construction due to the large number of variations
body:
The mod requires the Neoforge 1.21.8  version and is not suitable for any version.
Missing items
My mod, which adds more than 100 new blocks.
Features:
A special feature of the mod are magma bricks that glow in the dark, and unlike magma,![Magma bricks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1eb6f84cba2fd138ae650cb7aa6539dc124f185a_0.webp) you always take damage from magma bricks when you stand on them. So, my mod adds a complete set of obsidian blocks,![Obsidian blocks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eae960c646cb626992315728f5f6e7a4d7fa8a72.png) among which there are blocks from crying obsidian, and if you make a house out of them, it will glow like a light bulb and then you don't need to use lanterns. Some of the blocks I added are exclusive and are only in my mod.
Goals:                                                                              
   The goal of the mod is to add more blocks to diversify the construction of the mod is still in development, and this is not the final version of it, so I would really appreciate your advice on what to add and for help in solving problems. Thanks for your attention! 
Mod author: Orcturus
